notes.title: Join the Developer for a ZombCube Play Session!
notes.content:
[h1]Let's Play ZombCube[/h1]
Attention ZombCube enthusiasts! We're thrilled to announce an exclusive play session with the developer of ZombCube. This is your chance to dive into the action-packed, zombie-filled world of ZombCube alongside the very person who brought it to life!

[h3]Details:[/h3]
Developer Play Session: Join our developer in the game and experience ZombCube in a whole new way. Ask questions, share feedback, and witness behind-the-scenes insights.
Live Q&A: Have burning questions about ZombCube? Now's your chance to get answers directly from the source.

[h3]How to Join:[/h3]
Launch ZombCube: Ensure you have the latest version of the game installed.
Join the Event Lobby: A special event lobby will be available with code, "ZombCube". Select Play -> Party -> Enter Code -> Join.
Interact: Use our Discord server #zombcube chat to communicate with the developer and other players. Share your thoughts and enjoy the game!

We can’t wait to see you there and have some zombie-slaying fun together!

[h3]Stay Connected:[/h3]
Follow us on our social media channels and join our Discord server to stay updated with all things ZombCube.

Discord: https://discord.gg/8Shu6xTRVP

Twitter: https://x.com/ZombCube


Happy gaming, and see you in ZombCube!

- Morgan Houston

notes.title: ZombCube Available Now!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that ZombCube is now available to play on Steam! Get ready to dive into an adrenaline-pumping, first-person, cross-platform, zombie survival game that will test your skills and teamwork.

Key Features:
🔹 First-Person Action: Immerse yourself in the intense world of ZombCube with a first-person perspective.
🔹 Cross-Platform Play: Join forces with friends on different platforms and conquer the waves together.
🔹 Zombie Survival: Face relentless waves of evil ZombCube's and fight for your survival.
🔹 Solo or Multiplayer: Whether you prefer to go solo or team up with friends, the choice is yours.
🔹 Leaderboards: Show off your skills and climb the leaderboards to become the best ZombCube destroyer out there.
🔹 BossCube: Reach wave 50 to take on the evil BossCube! If you defeat him, you then have the option to continue the action infinitely or quit.

Don't miss out on the ultimate zombie survival experience. Gather your friends, load your weapons, and get ready to face the challenge of ZombCube!

Join the fight now and prove your worth!
[previewyoutube=e2GCcN4HcZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035180/ZombCube/]ZombCube[/url] on Steam

See you on the battlefield!

- Morgan Houston
